nodes.description: HECW2 is a HECT-type E3 ligase whose WW domains bind PY motifs in its substrates. In cultured cells it ubiquitinates and stabilizes p73, enhancing p73-dependent transcription, and it targets PCNA, lamin B1 and HP1 alpha and beta for proteasomal degradation. In endothelial cells it stabilizes AMOTL1 by K63-linked ubiquitination, and in mice it promotes GDNF/RET/AKT signalling in enteric neural precursors through Nedd8 ligase activity. Which of these functions is lost or altered in patients, and in which cells, is not known.
